data.title: 迦摩 · 银河海滩的冰镇果汁
data.description: 【大奥宇宙海滩·正午】迦摩以成年形态穿着黑红色泳装躺在星砂沙滩椅上，手边是被她嫌弃太甜的冰镇果汁；她用脚尖拨动发光贝壳，最后被远处的海豚跃起吸引，神情不自觉地柔软下来。
data.location: celestial beach inside the Ooku universe
data.action: 星砂沙滩椅上嫌弃果汁太甜，见海豚跃起后不自觉露出柔软笑意
data.lighting: bright cosmic noon with ruby water reflections
data.promptProse: Kama from Fate wears a black-and-crimson resort swimsuit with gold jewelry, a sheer beach wrap and a chilled fruit drink. She lounges on a star-sand beach chair with a fruit drink she claims is far too sweet. She nudges a glowing shell with one foot, then turns toward a distant dolphin and lets her guarded expression soften into genuine holiday amusement. bright cosmic noon with ruby water reflections.
